app.name: Trust Pack Checker
hero.headline: Every answer comes with its proof.
hero.subline: Check a DPA against GDPR Article 28 and draft questionnaire answers backed by quotes from your own documents.
privacy.note: Your files stay in this browser tab.
footer.disclaimer: Draft for human review. Not legal advice.
footer.rulesNotReviewed: Rules not yet reviewed by a lawyer.
mode.title: What are you doing?
mode.company.title: I'm answering a questionnaire
mode.company.body: Draft answers from your own DPA and policies, each with a quote you can check.
mode.client.title: I'm reviewing a vendor
mode.client.body: Compare a vendor's DPA with their answers and get questions to send back.
mode.sampleNote: Synthetic documents for a fictional company. Nothing is uploaded.
upload.title: Add your documents
upload.drop: Drop a file here or choose one
upload.mapping.title: Where are the questions?
upload.mapping.question: Question column
upload.mapping.notDetected: No question column detected. Choose it below.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Nothing is uploaded to a server. Without AI, no data leaves this page.
ingest.warning.not_english: This text does not look like English. v1 supports English only; results may be poor.
ingest.error.scanned_pdf: This PDF looks scanned. v1 cannot read scanned PDFs. Export a text version or paste the text.
ingest.error.password: is password-protected. Remove the password and try again.
ingest.error.corrupt: could not be read. The file may be damaged.
ingest.error.unsupported_type: is not a supported file type.
review.tab.gaps: What your documents do not cover
review.export.libraryWarning: This file contains your document text.
review.import.failed: This file is not a Trust Pack Checker library.
review.empty: Select a question to see its evidence.
evidence.draftPlaceholder: Write the answer to send. Use only what the evidence supports.
evidence.passagesHelp: Select the sentence that answers the question, then use it as evidence.
evidence.selectionInvalid: The selected text must be at least 12 characters and come from one passage.
evidence.noPassages: No supporting passage in the documents provided.
evidence.needsDoc: Needs one of these documents to answer:
evidence.unclassified: Topic not recognised. Read the passages and decide.
evidence.unverified: The model's quote was not found in the document, so it is not shown as found.
evidence.detailsNotInEvidence: The draft contains details that are not in the evidence:
evidence.incorporated: Incorporated by reference; the referenced text was not provided and was not checked.
evidence.goodPractice: Good practice, not required by Art. 28
evidence.libraryOutdated: Earlier answer may be outdated: its quote is not in the current documents.
evidence.libraryUse: Use this answer as the draft
gaps.questions: Questions your documents do not answer
gaps.rules: Art. 28 elements not found in your DPA
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
notChecked.title: What this tool did not check
notChecked.body: Scanned PDFs, documents incorporated by reference (such as the SCC text), sub-processors' own contracts, and whether security controls exist in practice.
ai.title: Draft with AI (optional)
ai.enable: Use AI to draft answers and check clauses
ai.body: Uses your own Anthropic API key. Only the question and a few selected passages are sent, never whole files.
ai.remember: Remember the key on this device
ai.rememberWarning: The key is stored unencrypted in this browser. Anyone with access to this device can read it.
ai.failed: Some AI calls failed. Those items keep their no-AI result.
ai.authError: The API key was rejected. Results without AI are shown.
ai.recorded: Recorded run on synthetic documents, not live
consent.title: Send passages to Anthropic?
consent.provider: Provider: Anthropic (Claude API), called directly from this browser with your key.
consent.sent: What is sent: each question's text and up to about 1,500 words of selected passages, with a document label such as "DPA".
consent.notSent: Not sent: whole files or file names. Your key goes only to Anthropic.
consent.many: This is a large run. Check the estimate before you continue.
bento.evidence.title: Quotes checked by code
bento.evidence.body: An answer shows “Found in text” only when its quote appears word for word in your document.
bento.evidence.question: Who is the controller and who is the processor?
bento.evidence.quote: The Customer is the controller and Northwind is the processor of Customer Personal Data
bento.local.title: Stays in your browser
bento.local.body: No server and no account. Without AI, nothing leaves this page.
bento.rules.title: Art. 28 checks
bento.rules.body: Contract requirements and good-practice checks, each linked to the clause it relies on.
bento.export.title: Your file, filled in
bento.export.body: Export a copy of the questionnaire with drafts, quotes and sources. Your original cells stay unchanged.
results.title: How it does on test documents
results.note: Synthetic documents written for testing, checked without AI. Contract-check numbers include a pack written after the checks; the vendor number is only from a pack written after the latest fixes. Measured
results.passages: Questions with the right passage in the top 5
results.aiPending: Results with AI drafting will be added after the AI evaluation run.
vendor.kind.numbers-differ: The answer says {answer}; the DPA says {contract}.
vendor.kind.one-number: The answer says {answer}; the DPA says {contract}. Only one of them gives a number.
vendor.kind.none-vs-list: The answer says there are no sub-processors; the DPA lists {count}.
vendor.kind.unlisted-name: The answer names {name}, which is not on the DPA's sub-processor list.
vendor.kind.eu-only-vs-location: The answer says data stays in the EU/EEA; the DPA names a location outside it: {country}.
vendor.kind.audit-excluded: The answer offers audits; the DPA excludes them.
vendor.kind.audit-limited: The answer offers audits; the DPA limits audit rights to reports.
vendor.kind.ai-polarity: The answer and the DPA disagree on whether customer data is used to train AI or machine learning models.
vendor.kind.claim-unbacked: The answer claims {claim}; the DPA does not mention it. Not an error in itself: a DPA need not list every control.
vendor.none: These checks found no differences between the answers and the DPA. That does not mean the answers are correct.
vendor.noAnswers: No answers were read. Check that the answer column is chosen.
vendor.asks.intro: Draft questions. Edit them before you send them; nothing is sent from this tool.
vendor.asks.contradictions: Where the answers and the DPA differ
vendor.asks.contract: Art. 28 elements not found in the DPA
vendor.checks: Compared by code: breach notice and deletion periods, sub-processor names, EU/EEA location claims, audit rights, AI training statements and security claims.
upload.hint.answers: XLSX or CSV with a question column and an answer column.
upload.mapping.needAnswer: Choose the column with the vendor's answers.
results.vendor: Vendor contradictions found on a pack the checks had not seen
hero.audience: For small B2B companies answering customer security questionnaires and checking their vendors.
pilot.title: Have a DPA or a questionnaire due?
pilot.body: I review one DPA, customer questionnaire or vendor pack for free, in exchange for honest feedback. You get a completeness check against Art. 28 and draft answers with the source of each. Completeness check and draft, not legal advice.
pilot.note: This is a manual review by me, outside the tool. Nothing leaves your browser when you use the tool itself.
tested.title: Where it works and where it misses
tested.intro: Seven synthetic packs with answer keys. Packs marked "held out" were written after the checks were built, so they are the fairer test. Every miss is listed below.
vendor.kind.omitted-name: The answer leaves out sub-processors that the DPA lists: {names}.
results.vendorBuilt: Vendor contradictions found on packs used to build the checks
